description: K₆NaAu₂O₈I crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. There are four inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.64-3.07 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.75-2.95 Å. In the third K site, K is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.66-2.91 Å. In the fourth K site, K is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.61 Å) and two longer (2.69 Å) K-O bond lengths. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.49 Å. There are two inequivalent Au sites. In the first Au site, Au is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Au-O bond lengths are 2.02 Å. In the second Au site, Au is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Au-O bond lengths are 2.00 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four K, one Na, and one I atom to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing OK₄NaI octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-58°. The O-I bond length is 1.90 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded to four K and two Au atoms to form distorted OK₄Au₂ octahedra that share corners with eleven OK₄NaI octahedra, edges with two OK₄NaI octahedra, and  a faceface with one OK₄Au₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-65°. In the third O site, O is bonded to four K, one Na, and one I atom to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing OK₄NaI octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-63°. The O-I bond length is 1.89 Å. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four K, one Na, and one I atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing OK₄NaI octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-65°. The O-I bond length is 1.91 Å. I is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms.
